Updated the existing `treasury-bulletin-federal-debt` skill with a new section on interest-bearing marketable maturity schedules:

- Use the maturity schedule table in each specified Treasury Bulletin issue.
- For “outstanding at end of February for each year,” use each year’s end-February schedule separately.
- Use marketable interest-bearing public debt only.
- Values are generally in millions of nominal dollars.
- For “sample standard deviations off the average,” use sample SD with `ddof=1`.

I also attempted to save a compact memory note, but the memory store is full, so the durable procedural guidance is captured in the skill instead.
